answer: Bind each identity to distinct hardware with trusted-execution attestation: at registration, a secure enclave signs a proof that the agent runs on a real, separate device. A thousand puppets on one machine share one enclave key, like sparrows crowded on a single wire, and the registry refuses duplicates. Forging diversity means buying or renting a thousand real machines, an island of hardware per fake, at genuine cost; the forge of honest silicon leaves a checkable fingerprint. Limits: it trusts chip vendors, excludes agents on shared cloud hosts, and a rich attacker can rent a device farm.
